title: NORMDIAL: A Comparable Bilingual Synthetic Dialogue Dataset for Modeling Social Norm Adherence and Violation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating and comparing a Large Language Model's (ChatGPT's) zero-shot or few-shot performance (Precision, Recall, F1-Score) in accurately detecting social norm adherences and violations across two distinct cultural contexts (Chinese and American) using a bilingual synthetic dialogue dataset.
